definition.finite_word: A linear word of non-4 gaps between left and right period-four bulk sectors.
definition.support: from the first abnormal gap to the last abnormal gap
definition.equivalence: translation is removed by putting the first left defect at 0; reflection reverses the gap word
definition.decomposable: contains a proper contiguous zero-charge subword or an intervening bulk gap 4
definition.primitive: canonical under reflection and not decomposable by the bounded definition

proof_boundary: The search is exhaustive only in the displayed finite alphabet and support length. It cannot prove uniqueness among all primitive interfaces.
